hypothesis: Public-observation TRAIN learns a modular probability distribution over reusable two-input Boolean causal gates and their composition operator. Factorized learned gate priors improve calibrated counterfactual forecasts on source-born unfamiliar combinations and causal relationships at complete native cost no greater than the strongest equally trained independent, full-rule and fully trained joint-composition controls.

mechanism.known_hypothesis_grammar: Eight distinct two-input Boolean gate atoms; two shared gates compose as XOR or AND on three delayed entity inputs: F(a,b,c)=G(a,b) OP H(b,c). Hidden gate identities, OP and causal rule unknown for each case.
mechanism.train: Fit probabilities P(G),P(H),P(OP) by exact public-likelihood EM over every possible 8x8x2 latent composition; no hidden pair labels or query truth in fitting.
mechanism.prediction: Bayesian model averaging across public-consistent gate compositions using TRAIN factors; exact hard certifications separately from all 256 Boolean truth tables matching public evidence. Unknown future outcomes must be forecast probabilistically, never certified by threshold.
mechanism.ablation: Remove fitted factor distributions, replace with uniform gate/operator weights on identical source evidence, show numerical change in TRAIN-validation probabilities and identical hard certifications.
mechanism.fairness: Competitor trains complete categorical P(G,H,OP) with identical EM iterations, public cases, support and smoothing. Also train complete P(256 truth tables), and independent Beta-per-input patterns; verify strongest.

families.C: 8 entities, delayed three-input Boolean causal updates, TRAIN chain histories, prospective new rewired feedback graphs
families.D: 10 entities, cross-time lagged causal updates, TRAIN local ring relationships, prospective hub/feedback graphs

source.new_pair_holdout: Prospective component pairs never used in TRAIN-meta or TRAIN-validation but individual atom gate identities are observed across public TRAIN; holdout criteria fixed before source birth.

scoring.certification: zero wrong hard certifications verified against independently reconstructed all-256-function exact posterior
scoring.uncertainty: at least 20% and no more than 90% of TRAIN-validation 64 questions unresolved
scoring.proper_forecasting: Brier loss over unresolved answers, at least 5% lower versus BEST equally informed fully trained comparator on separate TRAIN-validation
scoring.ablation: fitted parameters change numerical forecasts for at least one TRAIN-validation world
scoring.native: five whole-process trials per arm on GitHub-hosted Windows and Linux including training, generation, scoring; strict median CPU below every strongest fully trained exact control and maximum peak RSS no greater than best comparator BOTH OS

identity: Preregister exact case counts, seeds, new pair partition, hypotheses and native thresholds before source code. Original prospective DEV never generated/opened prior to successful TRAIN admission. No post-hoc retuning/selection.
